Residents at 229 Wythe Avenue are moments away from restaurants, trendy coffee shops, boutique shopping, art galleries, music venues, and the scenic East River waterfront that provides convenient ferry access. The thoughtfully designed one- and two-bedroom apartments feature spacious layouts, contemporary finishes, energy-efficient appliances, and air conditioning, offering a perfect blend of comfort and style. Complete with a fully equipped fitness center* and a stunning outdoor terrace*, the building provides the perfect setting for elevated living in the heart of North Williamsburg. (*fees apply) No pets allowed, except service animals. Tenants are responsible for electricity, including stove, hot water, and heat.

advertisementContent.projectSpecificDetails: Blondell Commons is a 126-unit new construction located at 1340 Blondell Avenue in Westchester Square section of the Bronx Community Board 11. The development offers modern apartment layouts with energy-efficient features.  The amenities include 24-hour Attended Lobby, On-site Resident Manager, Fitness Center, Art Room, Children Playroom, Free In-unit Broadband Internet, Community Room, Card-Operated Laundry Room**, Parking Spaces available on a first-come first-serve basis** (**additional fees apply).  The Westchester Square section of the Bronx offers a residential neighborhood setting with convenient access to local businesses, public transportation, schools, parks, healthcare facilities, and community services. There is convenient access to nearby transportation to the 6 train and the BX4, BX4A, BX8, BX24, BX31, BX40 AND BX42 buses. The building is pet- friendly, subject to restrictions and management approval.  Tenants responsible for electric with electric stove.
